services.name: Large Groups & Private Events
services.desc: Voted the Best Golf Course in Houston by Houston Press, East River 9 is available for your next big event! Whether your party is interested in booking the golf course and driving range for a fun outing, competing in a pickleball tournament on our six courts, or hanging at our beautiful restaurant and patio bar while enjoying delicious food and drinks, live music, and an iconic view of the downtown skyline, we are the place for you. We are a one-of-a-kind destination for hosting standout corporate outings, social gatherings, and charitable events. Our dynamic venue is perfect for private golf and/or pickleball tournaments, fundraisers, bachelor and bachelorette parties, rehearsal dinners,
